AuthenticationMethod.description: Active authentication method for the Portainer instance. Valid values are: 1 for internal, 2 for LDAP, or 3 for oauth

BlackListedLabels.description: A list of label name & value that will be used to hide containers when querying containers

EdgePortainerURL.description: EdgePortainerURL is the URL that is exposed to edge agents

EnableEdgeComputeFeatures.description: Whether edge compute features are enabled

EnforceEdgeID.description: EnforceEdgeID makes Portainer store the Edge ID instead of accepting anyone

GlobalDeploymentOptions.description: Deployment options for encouraging deployment as code

LogoURL.description: URL to a logo that will be displayed on the login page as well as on top of the sidebar. Will use default Portainer logo when value is empty string

SnapshotInterval.description: The interval in which environment(endpoint) snapshots are created

TemplatesURL.description: URL to the templates that will be displayed in the UI when navigating to App Templates

TrustOnFirstConnect.description: TrustOnFirstConnect makes Portainer accepting edge agent connection by default

UserSessionTimeout.description: The duration of a user session

GroupAttribute.description: LDAP attribute which denotes the group membership

GroupBaseDN.description: The distinguished name of the element from which the LDAP server will search for groups

GroupFilter.description: The LDAP search filter used to select group elements, optional

BaseDN.description: The distinguished name of the element from which the LDAP server will search for users

Filter.description: Optional LDAP search filter used to select user elements

UserNameAttribute.description: LDAP attribute which denotes the username

AnonymousMode.description: Enable this option if the server is configured for Anonymous access. When enabled, ReaderDN and Password will not be used

AutoCreateUsers.description: Automatically provision users and assign them to matching LDAP group names

Password.description: Password of the account that will be used to search users

ReaderDN.description: Account that will be used to search for users

StartTLS.description: Whether LDAP connection should use StartTLS

URL.description: URL or IP address of the LDAP server

TLSCACert.description: Path to the TLS CA certificate file

TLSCert.description: Path to the TLS client certificate file

TLSKey.description: Path to the TLS client key file

TLSSkipVerify.description: Skip the verification of the server TLS certificate
